subject: Multisite private deploy: EU->APAC residency & egress control handover
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Park <alice.park@acme-telecom.com>, Kenneth Li <kenneth.li@acme-telecom.com>
Date: 2027-04-04T09:12:00Z
Subject: Multisite private deploy: EU->APAC residency & egress control handover

Team / Acme,

Quick heads-up: Acme wants us to finalize the residency proof and egress gating plan before the control-plane cutover window (target May 2). The two sticking points from legal/security are: (1) demonstrable egress blackout from EU tenants to third-party destinations during APAC failover, and (2) clearly scoped KMS key residency and rotation for APAC cluster copies.

I've attached a first-pass residency matrix and a network sketch. Can we align on concrete verification steps we can present to Acme next week? Specifically I want:
- A short checklist we can run during the DR cutover (egress testcases, packet captures to hand to Acme)
- KMS proof plan (who rotates keys, where key material resides, how we attest)
- A failover trigger matrix (latency/capacity thresholds + manual approval gates)

Action: Vivek/Jordan/Priyom — can you review the two attachments and propose a verification checklist by EOD Tuesday? Neha, can you validate whether the residency matrix meets our SOC evidence template or if we need additional fields for ACME procurement?

Thanks,
Naomi

--
Naomi Feldman
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com
[Attachment: residency_matrix_v1.xlsx (xlsx)]
[Attachment: network-egress-controls-diagram.pdf (pdf)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Park <alice.park@acme-telecom.com>
Date: 2027-04-04T14:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Multisite private deploy: EU->APAC residency & egress control handover

Naomi / team,

Thanks — quick read of the diagram and matrix. High level notes:
- Egress blackout is doable via SG + egress ACLs on the APAC VPC combined with strict NAT gateway routing. We should capture a baseline of allowed services (DNS, ntp, internal telemetry) vs blocked egress destinations.
- For proof, I recommend we produce: (1) a scripted iptables/iproute2 test that attempts outbound to a small set of blocked destinations, (2) a pcapture of a dropped flow, and (3) a signed statement of routing table applied during the window.
- KMS: we can implement APAC key wrapping with HSM-backend in APAC region and add a key policy restricting export. We need to confirm Acme's required FIPS / HSM attestation level.

I will draft the verification checklist and a short test playbook. Tentative delivery: Tuesday 2027-04-06 COB.

—Vivek

--
[Attachment referenced: kms-scope-proposal.md (md)]

From: Alice Park <alice.park@acme-telecom.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Kenneth Li <kenneth.li@acme-telecom.com>, procurement@acme-telecom.com
Date: 2027-04-05T08:27:00Z
Subject: Re: Multisite private deploy: EU->APAC residency & egress control handover

Naomi — thank you. A few clarifications from our side:
1) Procurement needs a single PDF that lists the evidence items we'll receive post-cutover (pcaps, signed routing snapshot, key policy doc).
2) Security needs a simple pass/fail checklist we can attach to our change request; it must include a test that validates no user or telemetry data leaves EU under failover conditions.
3) For KMS, Acme's control requires the wrapping key to be created in APAC and rotated quarterly. If Redwood cannot rotate the key on our schedule, we need a documented procedure for manual rotation by Acme.

Can your team confirm whether the key material will be accessible to Acme's KMS team for manual rotation? If not, we will log that as a gap and propose an alternative.

Regards,
Alice
Alice Park
Solutions Owner, Acme Telecom
[Link: https://acme.atlassian.com/browse/REQ-4543]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Alice Park <alice.park@acme-telecom.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Kenneth Li <kenneth.li@acme-telecom.com>
Date: 2027-04-05T13:16:00Z
Subject: Re: Multisite private deploy: EU->APAC residency & egress control handover

Alice — thanks for the clarity. Short answers:
- We can produce the single PDF package for procurement; Neha will help assemble the evidence artifacts.
- The pass/fail checklist will include an automated outbound block test that runs before enabling traffic switchover. We'll record the run and include the pcap.
- KMS rotation: Redwood's typical model is to manage keys on behalf of the customer in private deployments, but we can support a manual rotation workflow by generating key material and transferring it to Acme's KMS team under an approved HSM export procedure if Acme requires it. That will require scheduling and a brief change freeze.

Action items:
1) Vivek: verification checklist + playbook (due 2027-04-06 COB)
2) Neha: assemble procurement PDF + evidence template (due 2027-04-07 noon)
3) Priyom: confirm routing snapshot tooling and sign-off process (due 2027-04-07 EOD)

I'll schedule a 30-minute sync tomorrow to walk Acme through the cutover test steps.

—Jordan

--

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Park <alice.park@acme-telecom.com>
Date: 2027-04-06T10:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Multisite private deploy: EU->APAC residency & egress control handover

Team — attaching the procurement-ready evidence checklist (will produce final PDF once we have the pcaps and routing snapshot). Notes on matrix: added two extra columns — "evidence artifact name" and "retention window (days)" to align with our SOC template.

Quick question for Acme: what retention window do you require for the cutover pcaps? Our standard is 90 days; if you need 365 we'll confirm storage and cost impact.

Neha

--
Neha Kapoor
Security Compliance Specialist, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: residency_matrix_v1.xlsx (updated)]

From: Kenneth Li <kenneth.li@acme-telecom.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Alice Park <alice.park@acme-telecom.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-07T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Multisite private deploy: EU->APAC residency & egress control handover

Naomi / team — quick update from Network Ops: Acme can accept a 90-day retention window for pcaps. For the KMS manual rotation option, we prefer an HSM-export process where Redwood performs the export under ops supervision (timeboxed) and hands the wrapped key to Acme in a transfer container. We'll take the manual rotation if the automated quarterly rotation by Redwood is not possible.

We're available for the 30-minute sync Jordan proposed — Thursday 2027-04-08 09:30 UTC works for us. Please send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Kenneth
Network Operations — Acme Telecom
[Attachment: none]
